description_en: Queries the configurations of the vulnerability scan feature for a server
description_zh: 获取单台机器漏洞开关配置
kebab_example: aliyun sas describe-vul-target-config --type cve --uuid ae1527a9-2308-46ab-b10a-48ae7ff70000 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeVulTargetConfig

parameters.help_en:
The type of the vulnerability. Valid values:

cve: Linux software vulnerability
sys: Windows system vulnerability
cms: Web-CMS vulnerability
emg: urgent vulnerability
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的漏洞类型。取值：

cve：Linux漏洞
sys：Windows漏洞
cms：WebCMS漏洞
emg：应急漏洞
parameters.name: type

TargetConfigs.description_en: An array that consists of the configurations
TargetConfigs.description_zh: 服务器漏洞配置信息列表

Config.description_en:
Indicates whether the vulnerability scan feature is enabled for the server.

off: disabled
on: enabled
Config.description_zh:
机器对应的漏洞开关。

off：关闭
on：开启

OverAllConfig.description_en:
Indicates whether the vulnerability scan feature is enabled for all servers. Valid values:

off: disabled
on: enabled
OverAllConfig.description_zh:
全局开关。取值：

off：关闭
on：开启

Type.description_en:
The type of the vulnerability. Valid values:

cve: Linux software vulnerability
sys: Windows system vulnerability
cms: Web-CMS vulnerability
emg: urgent vulnerability
Type.description_zh:
要查询的漏洞类型。取值：

cve：Linux漏洞
sys：Windows漏洞
cms：WebCMS漏洞
emg：应急漏洞

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
